data.short_meaning: Hart: stag, deer; ley: clearing, wood, meadow
data.long_meaning: The name Hartley is derived from Old English hart leah, meaning a clearing or meadow where deer are found. It is a unisex name but is predominantly used for boys in modern English-speaking countries. The name has a strong connection to nature and symbolizes courage and strength, much like the deer it is named after. The name Hartley carries the meaning “Hart: stag, deer; ley: clearing, wood, meadow” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Hartley usually hope their child will grow to embody hart: stag, deer; ley: clearing, wood, meadow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
